post.description:
Authenticates a user with email and authKey.
Session token is set via HttpOnly cookie (not in response body).
Client should derive authKey from password using Argon2id + HKDF.

200.description: Login successful. Session cookie is set.

post.description: Clears the session cookie. Client should also clear DSK from IndexedDB.

get.summary: Get current user info and encrypted keys
get.description:
Returns user info and encrypted keys for session restoration.
Requires valid session cookie. Used when client has DSK cached but needs encrypted keys.

post.description:
Creates a new user account with password authentication and E2EE keys.
All encryption is performed client-side; server stores encrypted data only.
Registration is atomic - all entities are created in a single transaction.

get.summary: Get salt and KDF parameters for login
get.description:
Returns the salt and KDF parameters needed to derive the master key.
For unknown users, returns a deterministic dummy salt to prevent user enumeration.
KDF parameters are always the global default settings.

The device uses its ECDH private key and the sender's ECDH public key
to derive the shared secret and decrypt the UMK.

GetSasResponse.description:
Get SAS response

Get SAS response - returns device public keys for client-side SAS calculation.

For MITM detection, clients MUST calculate SAS locally using
`device_signing_public_key`, `device_ecdh_public_key`, `client_nonce`
and their LOCAL identity signing public key.

client_nonce.description: Client nonce (base64url, 16 bytes) - for client-side SAS calculation
